title: Quarry Mason
backstory: Bram Stonecalm was a marker before he was a mason: the person trusted to decide which stone was safe to cut and which should stay holding the hill together. In Founders Plot he gives the quarry a culture of measurement rather than extraction, making existing server-owned stone production feel deliberate and cared for.
personality: Calm, exact, and steady under noise. He speaks softly because rock already does enough shouting.

idle.description: Inspecting a small stone sample, marker tag, or measuring cord before Quarry work begins.

walk.description: Walking with a sample crate or marker bundle.

cut.description: Carefully marking and splitting stone with safe hand tools and a subtle cyan fracture-scanner cue.

ready.description: Presenting a stacked stone sample and sealed receipt pouch for ready Quarry output.
